Dexory tests NVIDIA Halos for warehouse robot safety architecture

The company is exploring an IGX Thor-based single-board approach before a planned worldwide fleet rollout.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗21 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Testing next-generation capabilities

Dexory announced on October 21 that it is testing NVIDIA Halos, which combines real-time AI, functional safety and edge computing through IGX Thor. The work targets warehouse robots operating alongside people, forklifts and other moving equipment.

Building on warehouse operations

DexoryView combines autonomous robot data and digital twins to describe inventory and warehouse space. The company is exploring a single-board architecture for broader perception and inside-out safety, building on its existing use of NVIDIA Cosmos for warehouse intelligence.

A rollout plan is not completed certification

Dexory plans to deploy the technology across its worldwide fleet but gives no start date or quantitative test results. Testing does not establish that every robot is upgraded or that a new safety certification is complete. Results remain dependent on development and validation.
